title: A membrane under the wave and heat equations
lede: A square sheet with its edges held at zero. Click or drag to poke it, then watch the same poke evolve under two different equations. Red is up, blue is down.
notice: Under the wave equation a poke becomes a ring that spreads at a fixed speed, bounces off the held edges and flips sign. The slight damping slowly lets the motion die out.
Under the heat equation a poke only spreads out and flattens. Nothing travels, nothing reflects, and the sheet relaxes toward zero.
Both schemes are explicit, and each time step respects its stability limit. The readout shows how close to the limit it runs.
hint: Click or drag on the sheet to poke it. Switch equation or press Reset.
